svg.title: ADR 0010: the four views from one geometry object

g.text: 1. Thinline: the main track as one line, no glyphs
keeps: rows whose circuit stands under a Rule 261 sign, closed into one line; the circuits' lamps; the masts that govern it;
the NextCP ends. drops: the siding (Rule 105) and its mast, the industries, the switch, every joint, the house, every glyph.
2. Model board: every placement, drawn with the written glyphs
keeps: every row; every placement drawn with its glyph from glyphs{} (19 here) through the placement transform, with the
drawn strokes and fills; names from the keys. styles: the board's for track and labels only.
3. Route finder: the board plus an evaluated route
836NB: 1NAT, 835 reverse, 2SAT, laid over the same rows and the switch glyph's own diverging leg (its R port). The route is
the evaluator's (view §5); geometry only says where to paint it.
4. Documentation packet: the board at print scale beside its tables
the picture generator's board, re-targeted to the Layout Data Model File, printed with the appliance, device and binding
